description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Organic growth is being rebuilt. Traditional SEO is being disrupted by AI driven answer engines that synthesize information directly rather than listing links. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) is the emerging frontier, optimizing for LLM visibility, ensuring your brand and products appear in AI generated answers, and building content systems that earn organic presence in a world where the algorithm is an intelligence, not just a crawler.

As Growth Workflow Specialist (Organic Growth), you will automate and scale the organic growth engine. Working closely with our organic growth strategy lead, you translate SEO and AEO strategy into automated workflows, content brief generation pipelines, LLM visibility monitoring, content deployment automation, competitor gap analysis, and more. You are the person who takes what the strategist knows and makes it run at the speed and scale that only automation enables.

While your primary focus is organic search and content distribution, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO content, onboarding copy, geo localized content workflows, and other growth surfaces, as the engine expands. The systems thinking transfers across every growth function.

The opportunity


Build and maintain the organic growth automation pipeline, from keyword and visibility signal ingestion to content brief generation to CMS deployment
Work with the organic growth strategy lead to translate SEO/AEO strategy into workflow specs the build team can implement
Monitor LLM visibility across priority topics, products, and markets, and automate the alerting and response workflows when visibility shifts
Automate content brief generation, pulling competitive gaps, search signal, and AEO data into structured briefs that feed the AI creative layer
QA content outputs from the AI content agents, ensuring accuracy, brand alignment, and SEO/AEO best practice compliance before deployment
Define knowledge base inputs for the organic growth agents, what content rules, standards, and market specific requirements should be codified
Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers as the engine scales, CRO content, onboarding copy, localization workflows, and beyond


What You Bring


3+ years in SEO with strong technical understanding, you understand how crawling, indexing, and ranking work, and you think about content as a system
Familiarity with AEO and LLM visibility concepts, you understand how AI answer engines work and what it takes to appear in them
CMS and content pipeline experience, comfortable working with content management systems and automated content deployment workflows
Systems thinking, you can map an organic content workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements
Data comfort, you can interpret organic performance data, identify what's working, and define what an agent should optimize for
Strong written communication, your workflow specs become the build team's blueprints. Precision matters. 


Nice to haves


Experience with programmatic SEO or content automation at scale
Familiarity with SEO monitoring, LLM visibility tracking, or competitive intelligence platforms
Background in regulated industries where content compliance adds complexity
Any hands-on experience with workflow automation or no-code orchestration tools

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives.



Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.





Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.





We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

This role is key to driving business growth in Mexico, supporting the Regional Business Generation team and aligning with Turner & Townsend’s global strategy, brand ambition, and values. The position combines strategic marketing, client development, and bid management, ensuring a strong pipeline of opportunities and increased win rates.

Business Generation & Marketing

Increased win rate and pipeline quality

description:
About the job

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Migration Delivery Lead is a high-impact individual contributor responsible for leading complex, high-stakes customer migration engagements from inception to successful validation. Operating at the tip of the spear, you function as the primary technical and strategic orchestrator for a specific migration pod, ensuring that customers achieve rapid time-to-value while migrating to modern cloud architectures. This role is built on a deep, seamless partnership with the Global Delivery Center (GDC), and Outbound Product Management as an aligned unit to ensure flawless, around-the-clock execution of migration engagements.

This role is designed for a versatile expert who thrives at the absolute intersection of customer relationship management and rigorous technical execution. You will act as a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between the customer’s legacy environment and their future-state platform by aggressively driving the adoption of automated playbooks and cutting-edge AI tools to dramatically compress delivery timelines. Beyond execution, you serve as a critical voice of the customer within the migration team feedback loop, systematically capturing real-world field insights, user friction, and system limitations to advocate directly to Product and Engineering for tool optimization. By orchestrating a unified front between the client, the account team, and your GDC engineering partners, you ensure that every engagement eliminates bespoke manual effort in favor of scalable, automated transformation.

Responsibilities

Customer Engagement and Value Alignment


Serve as the primary lead for customer migration engagements, responsible for the technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.
Partner closely with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration technical goals with the broader customer business strategy and renewal/expansion targets.
Successfully manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, translating complex migration roadblocks into actionable business decisions.
Develop and execute basic plans to focus time on high-impact milestones, taking full responsibility for pod-level project tasks and timelines.
Conduct enablement and alignment sessions with customer stakeholders to ensure their workforce is prepared for the platform transition.


Strategic Partnership and Tooling Adoption


AI-Driven Delivery: Drive the adoption and usage of toolkits, using AI agents and automation to accelerate discovery, mapping, and code conversion.
GDC Collaboration: Partner deeply with the Global Delivery Center (GDC) team, offloading repeatable technical tasks while maintaining overall accountability for the quality of the output.
Outbound Product Liaison: Work in lockstep with Outbound Product Managers to stay ahead of product roadmaps and provide field feedback that influences future migration patterns.
Identify underutilized platform features and align the migration roadmap to increase customer throughput and adoption of modern platform capabilities.


Technical Health and Subject Matter Expertise


Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the primary SME in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud, Data 360, Revenue Cloud, or Tableau, providing deep-dive technical guidance during the migration.
AI Literacy: Proficiency in using natural-language commands and prompt engineering to guide AI agents in retrieving data and generating migration health reports.
Incident Interface: Serve as the technical point of contact for major migration incidents, coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer’s revenue during "cutover" phases.
Proactively monitor technical trends and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure the migrated environment is optimized for performance and stability.


Required Qualifications


Experience: 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a specific focus on large-scale migrations.
Domain Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
Consulting Skills: Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and handle objections at the stakeholder level.
Technical Fluency: Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business terms and guide customers through complex data transformations.
Collaboration: Proven track record of working successfully with global/offshore delivery models (GDC) to accelerate project timelines.


Cloud/Platform & Technical Requirements


Platform Mastery: Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service) or specialized clouds (Marketing/Data/Revenue/Tableau).
AI Engagement: Familiarity with using AI agents or automation tools to handle data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
Integration Knowledge: Understanding of how the target cloud integrates with telephony, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.


Preferred Qualifications


Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, or Tableau Desktop Specialist).
Prior experience as an Individual Contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation projects.
Advanced AI Associate or "Agentblazer" certifications.


Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Performance marketing is being rebuilt from first principles. The manual processes of bid management, creative iteration, budget allocation, and audience targeting are being replaced by agent systems that detect signals, make decisions, and execute continuously, learning from every result. This is not incremental improvement. It is a different model.

As Growth Workflow Specialist (Performance & Paid Growth), you sit at the intersection of paid growth expertise and AI systems thinking. You are the domain expert who makes the automation intelligent. The engineers build what you spec. The agents run what you design. Your job is to define the logic, what signals matter, what decisions should be automated, what guardrails must exist, what the creative feedback loop looks like across paid channels, and then work alongside the build team to bring it to life.

While your primary focus is performance and paid growth, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO, incentives, referrals, and cross-channel workflows, as the engine expands. The domain expertise is your anchor. The systems thinking is what scales it.

This role is for someone who has run growth at scale and found themselves constantly asking why are we doing this manually. If you've felt the ceiling of what human-operated paid growth can achieve and want to build the system that breaks through it, this is that role.

The opportunity


Define and spec automation workflows for paid growth, from creative fatigue detection to budget reallocation to geo level channel mix optimization to audience signal processing
Work directly with the build team to translate your workflow specs into working agent automations
QA agent outputs, review what the system produces, identify where it falls short, and define the corrections that improve it
Refine creative and copy variants generated by the AI creative layer, applying domain judgment to what will perform before the data confirms it
Define knowledge base inputs for the paid growth agents, what rules, guardrails, and campaign logic should be codified and kept current
Monitor workflow performance and continuously improve, this system compounds with your input, it does not run itself
Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers, CRO, incentives, referrals, and lifecycle, as the engine expands across growth functions


What You Bring


4+ years in performance or paid growth, you have run campaigns at scale across major paid channels and understand the mechanics deeply
Systems thinking, you can map a growth workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements. You think in logic, not just tactics
Comfort with data, you can read a performance dashboard, interpret signal from noise, and define what an agent should optimize for
Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs
Strong written communication, the workflow specs you write become the blueprints engineers build from. Clarity matters.
High agency, you define the work, you don't wait for it to be defined for you


Nice to haves


Experience with marketing automation, CRM, or lifecycle messaging systems
Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation frameworks
Background in fintech, consumer financial products, or regulated industries
Any hands-on experience with workflow automation or no-code orchestration tools

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

[부스터스 소개]

GLOBAL BRAND GROUP 'GLOBAL NO.1 BRAND GROUP'

부스터스는 자사몰과 세계 각지의 다양한 이커머스 채널을 통해 브랜드를 운영하며 놀라운 성장을 이어가고 있는 선도적인 브랜드 그룹입니다.

국내·외 D2C, 리테일, 소셜 미디어 등 전방위적 채널 전략을 구사하며, 데이터 기반의 신속한 의사결정과 효율적인 운영 시스템을 통해 지속가능한 성장 모델을 구축했습니다. 이러한 혁신적인 접근이 가시적인 성과로 이어져, 브랜드 사업을 시작한 첫 해부터 꾸준한 흑자 실현으로 탄탄한 사업 기반을 입증했습니다.

특히 대표 브랜드 '브랜든(Branden)'은 3년 만에 31,000%라는 폭발적인 성장률을 기록하며 국내 '오거나이저' 시장에서 독보적인 1위 브랜드로 자리매김 했습니다. 또한 '이퀄베리(EQQUALBERRY)'는 혁신적인 제품력으로 전 세계 소비자들에게 사랑받는 글로벌 뷰티 브랜드로 성장하고 있습니다. 현재는 뷰티, 패션 등 다양한 카테고리로 영역을 확장하며 새로운 성공 신화를 쓰고 있습니다.

부스터스는 '불패의 커머스 공식을 보유한 글로벌 No.1 브랜드 그룹' 이라는 원대한 비전을 향해 나아가고 있습니다. 혁신을 두려워하지 않는 도전정신으로 글로벌 시장을 선도할 열정 넘치는 인재를 기다립니다.

우리는 원석을 보석으로 만드는 장인 집단입니다.

부스터스는 시장에 존재하지만 아직 빛을 보지 못한 브랜드 ‘원석’을 발견해 가공합니다.

‘원석’의 아름다움이 가장 잘 발휘될 수 있는 모양, 크기, 색을 고민하고, 정밀한 작업을 거쳐 ‘보석’으로 재탄생 시킵니다.

그리고 이 ‘보석’의 아름다움이 전 세계적으로 인정받는 그날을 위해 부지런히 고민하며 나아갑니다.

title: Founding GTM Lead
description:
About the job

Who we are

REXX Studio is a venture studio that builds tech companies for legacy, underserved industries, and pre-sells the concepts directly to PE firms before they're fully built. REXX comes in as co-founder and first allocator on every company, so they have real skin in each bet.




Role Summary

You are the studio's full-funnel commercial operator. Your primary job is to go close - in person, on camera, or at the door, wherever the deal requires. For every venture in the early GTM phase, you are the first salesperson on the ground. You also build the outbound infrastructure and sales playbooks that founders inherit as they scale, and you run structured outreach to surface the domain experts who become REXX's next EIRs.




Key Responsibilities

● Act as the primary salesperson for each venture during the early GTM phase until the EIR is fully ramped

● Show up in person wherever the deal requires - travel, door-knock, and close without hesitation

● Prospect, sequence, follow up, and close deals personally through direct outreach

● Record every customer interaction to build reusable sales playbooks for incoming founders

● Run structured outreach to identify domain experts and potential EIR candidates for the studio

● Own early GTM for REXX Studio itself - outreach, positioning, and inbound interest generation




Requirements & Background

● Background in business, marketing, or roles involving direct selling and client acquisition

● Has closed deals where the answer started as a no

● Experience building outbound systems using tools like Apollo, Clay, or Instantly

● Fluent in both Spanish and English

● Relentless and high-output - willing to do the unglamorous, repetitive work of early sales

● Equally strong on camera and in person - can represent a brand credibly in any room

● Low ego, high ownership - the closer who also documents everything so others can replicate it

● AI-native approach to prospecting and sequencing to maximize human closing time

About the job

Misión del rol

Buscamos un/a Staff Product Designer que eleve el estándar de calidad de diseño en Monato y construya el Design System del producto, para dar consistencia, fundamentos y velocidad a los equipos de Producto y Marketing.




¿Por qué este rol importa?

Buscamos un/a Staff Product Designer para dar bases y criterio al trabajo de diseño, asegurando un Design System sólido y una guía clara para el equipo, y contribuyendo al crecimiento de los equipos de Producto Design y Brand.




Lo que harás

Construir el Design System de Monato, definiendo bases, componentes y reglas que hoy no existen, para dar consistencia al producto y facilitar el trabajo con herramientas de IA.
Dar feedback y orientación al equipo de diseño, elevando el estándar de calidad y ayudando a destrabar problemas de diseño en los squads donde participe.
Colaborar con los squads de producto, participando en refinamientos, entregas de sprint y hand-off a desarrollo, y proponiendo soluciones desde una perspectiva de product design.
Apoyar al equipo de branding, produciendo entregables de marca (logotipo, publicidad, piezas visuales) y fortaleciendo el book de branding del equipo.
Alinear el trabajo de diseño con marketing, atendiendo las solicitudes de branding y estableciendo un way of work sin fricciones entre ambos equipos.
Acompañar y desarrollar al equipo de diseño, transfiriendo criterio y experiencia en Design System sin tomar decisiones estratégicas por ellos.




Perfil y habilidades clave

+5 años de experiencia en diseño de producto, idealmente en fintech.
Experiencia en publicidad y branding.
Comprensión real del ciclo de producto: identificar cuándo un problema es de UX, de PM o de estrategia.
Portafolio con trabajo en IA que demuestre experiencia diseñando sistemas con comportamiento no determinista.
Experiencia construyendo o escalando un Design System desde etapas tempranas de una empresa.
Pensamiento estratégico, negociación y priorización.
Habilidad para alinear stakeholders y diagnosticar problemas con claridad.
Manejo de Figma, Claude y paquetería de Adobe.




Lo que obtendrás

La oportunidad de construir desde cero el Design System de Monato.
Ownership real sobre los fundamentos de diseño de producto y marca.
Un rol de staff con impacto directo en múltiples squads, sin reportar a un equipo fijo.
Espacio para liderar sin autoridad formal, orientando y desarrollando a otros diseñadores.
Participación en una compañía construyendo infraestructura financiera en México.




Acerca de Monato

En Monato construimos infraestructura financiera moderna para empresas en México, integrando servicios financieros de forma ágil y segura. Operamos en un entorno regulado donde la estabilidad y el cumplimiento son fundamentales, y diseñamos soluciones que reducen la fricción bancaria para habilitar el crecimiento de nuestros clientes. Somos un equipo orientado a la ejecución, enfocado en construir, iterar y mejorar constantemente.

About the job

Remoto | Latinoamérica




Liderarás la estrategia de crecimiento de un holding con empresas de salud, bienestar y tecnología, trabajando directamente con los fundadores para convertir oportunidades de negocio en resultados medibles.




No buscamos un director de marketing.




Buscamos a la persona que ayude a construir el crecimiento de un holding de empresas de salud y tecnología. Este no es un cargo para administrar campañas, revisar piezas creativas o coordinar calendarios de contenido. Es un cargo para alguien que entiende el negocio, identifica oportunidades, toma decisiones con datos y convierte estrategias en crecimiento comercial.




Trabajarás directamente con los fundadores diseñando la estrategia de crecimiento de un portafolio de empresas que incluye una clínica de atención primaria enfocada en la atención de adultos mayores y programas públicos de aseguramiento en salud, una clínica de cirugía plástica, una unidad de medicina estética y wellness, además de nuevas compañías que estamos desarrollando.




Cada empresa tiene un mercado diferente, un cliente diferente y retos diferentes, por eso buscamos una persona que disfrute construir, experimentar y escalar negocios.




Lo que esperamos de ti




Durante los primeros meses esperamos que seas capaz de:

Entender profundamente cada negocio antes de proponer soluciones.
Diseñar estrategias de crecimiento adaptadas a cada empresa del holding.
Construir sistemas de adquisición de clientes que puedan escalar.
Mejorar la conversión durante todo el recorrido del cliente.
Encontrar nuevas oportunidades de ingresos.
Definir indicadores claros para tomar mejores decisiones.
Diseñar experimentos, medir resultados y ajustar rápidamente.
Trabajar junto a los fundadores en decisiones comerciales y estratégicas.
Coordinar agencias, freelancers y proveedores externos cuando sea necesario.
Construir el equipo adecuado a medida que el negocio crezca.




Este cargo es para ti si…




La mayoría de estas afirmaciones describen tu experiencia.

✔ Has sido responsable del crecimiento de un negocio, no solamente de campañas de marketing.

✔ Has tomado decisiones pensando en ingresos, rentabilidad y retorno de la inversión.

✔ Sabes explicar con facilidad métricas como CAC, LTV, ROAS, conversión y costo de adquisición.

✔ Has administrado presupuestos importantes de marketing y entiendes que cada dólar invertido debe generar valor.

✔ Has construido procesos, equipos o áreas desde cero.

✔ Te sientes cómodo trabajando donde muchas cosas todavía no existen.

✔ Puedes pasar de la estrategia a la ejecución sin perder velocidad.

✔ Has trabajado en startups, empresas de alto crecimiento o has construido un negocio propio.

✔ Te gusta resolver problemas de negocio, no únicamente problemas de marketing.

✔ Hablas español e inglés con fluidez.




Probablemente este cargo no sea para ti si…




Tu experiencia se concentra principalmente en branding, redes sociales, relaciones públicas o comunicación.
Has gestionado campañas, pero nunca has sido responsable del crecimiento del negocio.
Buscas una organización donde todos los procesos ya estén definidos.
Esperas tener un equipo grande antes de empezar a generar resultados.
Prefieres supervisar el trabajo de otros antes que involucrarte directamente.
Necesitas instrucciones detalladas para avanzar.
Disfrutas más planear que ejecutar.




En nuestro equipo valoramos personas que construyen. No personas que esperan que todo ya esté construido.




Cómo trabajamos




Somos una empresa en crecimiento. Eso significa que aquí no existen departamentos enormes ni estructuras corporativas tradicionales. 
Esperamos líderes que disfruten involucrarse, tomar decisiones, probar ideas, aprender rápido y ejecutar.
Trabajarás con agencias, especialistas y proveedores externos cuando sea necesario, pero nunca perderás la responsabilidad sobre los resultados.




Si disfrutas construir desde cero, probablemente aquí te sentirás cómodo.




Lo que más valoramos




Nos importa mucho menos el cargo que aparece en tu hoja de vida que la forma en que trabajas.




Valoramos personas con:

Criterio de negocio.
Curiosidad.
Pensamiento estructurado.
Capacidad para priorizar.
Mentalidad de experimentación.
Rapidez para ejecutar.
Adaptabilidad.
Responsabilidad.
Orientación a resultados.




Compensación




Este cargo es bajo la modalidad de Independent Contractor. Incluye:




Salario base anual de USD $50,000.
Incentivos directamente relacionados con el crecimiento del negocio.
Participación en utilidades y/o esquemas de equity, de acuerdo con el impacto generado y la evolución de la empresa.
La oportunidad de construir y liderar el área de marketing y crecimiento conforme el holding continúe expandiéndose.




Un desempeño sobresaliente puede llevar la compensación total anual a un rango entre USD $150,000 y USD $250,000, gracias a un modelo donde el crecimiento del negocio y el crecimiento profesional van de la mano.




Antes de aplicar




Este cargo exige una combinación poco común. Necesitamos a alguien que pueda pensar como estratega y ejecutar como constructor. Alguien que disfrute hacer preguntas como:




¿Cómo hacemos crecer este negocio de forma rentable?
¿Qué oportunidad todavía no estamos viendo?
¿Qué parte del proceso comercial podemos mejorar?
¿Dónde estamos perdiendo clientes?
¿Qué deberíamos dejar de hacer para crecer más rápido?




Si esas conversaciones te resultan más interesantes que hablar únicamente de campañas, redes sociales o calendarios de contenido, probablemente este sea el reto que estás buscando.

description:
About the job

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

Our LATAM Solutions Consultants exist to help both internal and external stakeholders understand the value of Rippling's Global HR-Payroll products. Our Solutions Consultants partner closely with Account Executives, Account Managers, and AE leadership in supporting our prospective clients' and customers' Rippling evaluation process. You will work with our Product and Product Marketing teams to advance our Global GTM and enablement strategy, continuing to grow expertise across our organization.

About the job

Position

Customer Order Support

Job Description

Job Description

Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. Arrow Electronics guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of $30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. The company maintains 228 locations worldwide with over 85 countries served.

A Fortune 148 company with 22,00 employees worldwide, Arrow brings technology solutions to a breadth of markets, including telecommunications, information systems, transportation, medical, industrial, and consumer electronics. Arrow provides specialized services and expertise across the entire product lifecycle. Arrow does this by connecting customers to the right technology at the right place, time, and price. Arrow provides extraordinary value to customers and suppliers - the best technology companies in the world - and connects them through the company's industry-leading services.

At Arrow, we're currently looking for a Customer Order Support. In this position, you'll have the opportunity to contribute individually and as a team member in providing a great experience to our customers through order management for light manufacturing orders handling the end-to-end process.

What You’ll Be Doing


Provide expert internal and external customer service and sales support to customer engagements. Assist in maintaining performance expectations to further enhance Arrow's position within each customer and supplier.
Responsible for handling more complex discrepancies, interfacing directly with customers, recommending solutions and/or action plans to internal sales team staff. 
Responsible for the Order to Invoice Process including but not limited to: Order entry & maintenance (outside of Infosys), value added order entry & follow up, not first articles; managing inbound customer order formats (excel, pdf, fax, etc); work submits SSRQ (SIMS Setup Request) which includes Value Added. 
Support sales team with direct customer contact within Planned Demand and Quality assurance processes. Includes coordinating the e-Compass and Forecast Response reports with Infosys, providing first point of escalation after mismatch registrations or sales and Item Status Change reports.
Handle branch service requests, FQR (Field Quality Request) analysis, submit Customer Surveys (NAFTA, ISO Cert’s, Quality, etc) and correct post delivery issues. 
Work on reduce backlog mismatch registrations and errors in the system by contacting field application engineers, sales people or customers.

2-4 years of related experience supporting B2B customers (experience in similar companies/industries is a nice-to-have).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills; must be fluent in English.

description:
About the job

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

Why this role is important to us

SimCorp leverages the most sophisticated risk analytics and portfolio-construction tools on the market, with a globally diverse client base that challenges us to continue innovating.

SimCorp is currently seeking a qualified professional to join our Customer Support team as a full-time employee. The position will be based in our Mexico City office. Candidates should have a minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Economics, or 1-2 years of relevant experience with a related degree. Beyond the opportunity to work directly with clients, team members will gain invaluable industry experience while working in a challenging, yet fun work environment.

What You Will Be Responsible For


Research and respond to pricing, risk analysis, attribution, and risk modeling questions from clients. 
Provide structured and custom training for new and existing clients. 
Assist clients in translating their risk analytics strategies into SimCorp products, while providing helpful insights into SimCorp’s innovative methods. 
Assist Sales Team members in creating proof-of-concept analysis via portfolio analysis and product demonstrations. 
Provide expert guidance during evaluations of SimCorp's software products including initial training, day-to-day usage questions, and by supporting the Sales and Product Specialists teams during client trials. 
Assist sales organization as necessary to facilitate strong client retention and new business development. 
Collaborate with senior Client Services staff and other SimCorp resources in responding to advanced client inquiries. 


What We Value


Strong written and oral English communication skills. 
Minimum of a Master's in Finance, Quantitative Finance, Economics, or 1-2 years relevant experience with a related degree. 
Knowledge with or experience with multi asset class securities (equity, fixed income, FX, and derivatives). 
Understanding of risk management concepts such as greeks, VaR, and stress testing. 
Strong educational foundation in math and statistics, familiar with linear and non-linear methods of interpretation in market theory and quantitative disciplines of risk analytics / portfolio construction. 
Strong computer skills and experience with coding languages (R / Python preferred, Java a plus). 
Strong ability to problem solve and quickly identify problem resolution for clients. 
Passion for assisting and teaching clients how to maximize the benefit of SimCorp products. 


Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

description:
About the job

About Zegna

The global leader in luxury menswear, ZEGNA was founded in the Italian Alps in 1910. Part of the Ermenegildo Zegna Group, the brand remains true to the values of its visionary Founder, Ermenegildo Zegna, who believed in creating world-class fabrics in harmony with both nature and local communities—a philosophy embodied by Oasi Zegna, the home of our values. The inspiration behind the brand’s values, Oasi Zegna, continues to guide everything we do at ZEGNA — from supporting our people to fostering a culture of growth, where craftsmanship and innovation are core elements of our learning processes and long-term growth strategy.

YOUR ROLE AT ZEGNA

As Visual Merchandiser LATAM, based in Polanco, Mexico City, you will bring your unique strengths to the LATAM Visual Merchandising Department, helping us elevate the customer experience and support business performance across the region. Using your creativity, commercial sensibility, guest understanding, and passion for product, you will transform stores and windows into stages that celebrate ZEGNA’s creative direction and brand DNA, while ensuring alignment with global visual merchandising standards.

How You Bring It To Life

Here’s how you’ll bring this role to life each day — making it your own and shaping it with your unique talents and expertise:


Partner with our Store Planning and Merchandising teams to create and innovate impactful visual displays that inspire and engage customers.
Ensure visual consistency across all retail points in LATAM, bringing to life at a local level the centrally defined creative vision.
Collaborate with Store Managers and key stakeholders to enhance sales through visual merchandising, incorporating market feedback and product performance insights to support business growth.
Support the implementation and execution of seasonal visual merchandising guidelines, campaigns, and product presentations across the region.
Work closely with store teams, providing guidance and expertise from a visual merchandising perspective to ensure brand standards are maintained.
Source and recommend alternative products and solutions for interior presentations when needed.
Monitor the quality and effectiveness of visual merchandising executions, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
Stay informed on competitor activities, retail trends, and industry best practices to continuously elevate visual presentation standards.
Support new store openings, renovations, and special projects as required across the LATAM region.
Actively communicate market feedback, visual merchandising insights, and best practices to relevant stakeholders to strengthen the customer experience and support business objectives.
Actively communicate guest insights, product feedback, and key store updates within the team to help ensure guest satisfaction and support business goals.


Who You Are

This is how you show up:


You bring solid experience in retail visual merchandising, with a proven ability to execute and maintain premium brand presentation standards.
You can transform conceptual ideas into practical and impactful visual solutions.
You demonstrate a genuine passion for luxury, product storytelling, and brand excellence, with exceptional attention to detail and a hands-on approach.
You are willing and able to travel across the LATAM region as business needs require.


NATURALLY IN ZEGNA

Joining us means stepping into a world of excellence, where the uniqueness of our authenticity is rooted in the talents of our people, who together contribute to weaving a story of innovation and craftsmanship. You will become part of an ongoing journey of development, uncovering your talents while contributing to a proud legacy and a vibrant tomorrow.

About the job

Role Overview:

As a Marketing Specialist, you will be focused on leveraging marketing tactics and channels to create demand and leads to support the company’s highest goals. This will be done through a combination of creating & executing multichannel marketing strategies. This person will be required to execute marketing efforts by the direction of the head of marketing to achieve the team’s most important number (MIN).




This role requires a scrappy and experienced professional who is willing to execute elements of each campaign. This means they are capable of rolling up their sleeves and solving capacity problems themselves either by writing copy, editing a workflow, peeking into analytics, or directing an agency/vendor to get a job done. We know that not all functions of marketing can be done by one person - even the most amazing marketing specialist, but this role particularly requires a person who can execute certain tactics themselves when necessary to get results.




Outcomes

1. Execute High-Impact Webinars That Drive MQL Growth and Engagement

Why this matters: Webinars are one of Rotate Digital's highest-leverage tools for attracting, warming, and converting moving company owners into qualified leads. Execution quality directly impacts how the industry perceives us and how many new MQLs enter the pipeline every month.

How success looks:

Webinars (monthly) are planned, promoted, and executed on time with zero dropped balls 🎯
Registrant counts are consistently hitting or exceeding the monthly target
New MQLs generated from each webinar are tracked, segmented, and handed off intentionally
Post-webinar follow-up is structured, timely, and drives continued engagement
The webinar experience feels polished, professional, and worth showing up for
Every webinar produces repurposable content that feeds other channels




2. Own the MQL Journey and Drive Intentional Nourishment That Moves People Toward Sales

Why this matters: Rotate Digital has over 800 qualified contacts sitting in the MQL list at any given time. Right now, most of them are floating in an ocean with no current. Without intentional nourishment, these people time out after 90 days and disappear without ever talking to sales. Owning this journey means owning a huge piece of the pipeline. 🌊

How success looks:

Every MQL has a clear, documented experience from entry to exit
MQLs are receiving intentional, valuable touchpoints throughout their 90-day window
Engagement rates on MQL communications are tracked and improving over time
New MQLs (especially first-time webinar registrants) are identified, flagged, and personally touched by sales
The MQL list is growing month over month and contributing to booked sales conversations
Nobody is timing out without having experienced real value from Rotate Digital

Time-Out Rate

A minimum of 3 posts per week are going out across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok

description:
About the job

Project Lead

Job Details

Role: Project Lead (performance marketing)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $425,000 - $510,000 MXN Annually + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $425,000 - $489,000 MXN Annually + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!



About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining the Performance Department (performance marketing) as our Project Lead, you'll be responsible for providing stability within your team by supporting your direct manager through mentoring, training, and developing team members. You will also apply expert-level strategic thinking to promote sustainable project growth, ensuring long-term success in performance marketing initiatives.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Making expert-level project contributions, autonomously leading projects of varying complexity to a high standard of quality, with a focus on testing and creative problem solving, maintaining client success where applicable and reasonable while supporting others around you and teaching others to do the same.
Client: Exemplifying Thrive's standards for client success through strong day-to-day communication, agile and proactive problem solving, project management, and anticipating client needs.
People: Accountable for training and developing team members to be world-class performance marketers with Thrive's standards of quality and impact to aid in the growth of company performance expertise.
Company: Understands and takes action to be a key influencer and innovator in helping Thrive improve our products and services, and enhancing team member contributions while aligning individual contributions with the wider team or program objectives.


We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s mission, values, and processes, complete your technical onboarding bootcamp, and onboard onto your team, emphasizing on building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll put your learning, skills, and experiences into action by supporting on assigned client accounts, preparing and leading client calls, and helping your Strategist manage projects end-to-end.
In your first 90 days you’ll have become integrated into the team, becoming an efficient contributor and trusted partner to your assigned clients and team members. You’re starting to train others on the work we do. 


Qualifications


You have executed, maintained, and scaled performance marketing accounts of $100k-200k USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time including Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others.
You have experience directly collaborating with and supporting team members to achieve project & team goals. You have coached, mentored, or trained people before, helping them reach their career development goals.
You have advanced analytical skills and experience using data visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You have built your own dashboards before, or automated some manual reporting to make it more efficient. 
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, lead gen, etc), and have been responsible for leading projects end-to-end, including delegation to more junior team members.
You have successfully managed and grown client relationships via weekly touchpoint meetings and asynchronous communication, and were able to make strategic recommendations that helped grow their business in the form of quarterly planning meetings or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and creative-minded Creative Performance Strategist to join our team. This role is designed to bridge the gap between media performance and creative production. You will be responsible for dissecting creative performance data to understand why certain ads perform better than others, translating those insights into actionable strategies for our creative and media teams. You will work closely with our Creative/Pencil Lead and Media Buyers to optimize our creative output based on rigorous data analysis.

Key Responsibilities


 Creative Performance Analysis & Reporting
Analyze the performance of creative assets across various platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) to identify winning patterns and elements.
Evaluate creative components such as hooks, visuals, copy, and CTAs to determine their impact on key performance indicators (KPIs) like CTR, CPA, and ROAS.
Build and maintain comprehensive dashboards and reports that focus specifically on creative efficacy.
 Strategic Bridge & Briefing
Act as the primary liaison between the Media/Data teams and the Creative/Production teams.
Translate media performance data into creative "lessons learned" and actionable creative briefs for future production.
Collaborate with the Creative/Pencil Lead to integrate AI-driven insights into the creative workflow.
 Testing & Optimization Frameworks
Develop and manage a robust creative testing roadmap, including A/B testing and multivariate testing protocols.
Provide data-backed recommendations for creative iterations and optimizations.
Oversee the metadata tagging process for creative assets to ensure granular data collection and analysis.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
Participate in regular cross-departmental syncs to align creative production with media buying strategies.
Educate the creative team on performance metrics and how their work impacts the bottom line.
Stay ahead of industry trends and platform updates to ensure our creative strategies remain cutting-edge.


Requirements & Skills

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in media analysis, digital marketing, or a performance-driven creative role. Advanced English proficiency. 

Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Google Data Studio, Tableau) and platform native analytics.

Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of Paid Social and Programmatic ads platforms

Creative Intuition: A strong grasp of storytelling, visual design principles, and what resonates with audiences on social media.

Tool Proficiency: Experience with AI-driven creative tools (e.g., Pencil) and creative management platforms is highly desirable.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Savings fund: You'll save 5% of your monthly income and Jellyfish will contribute the same amount you save to your savings fund.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

🏥 Health Insurance: We provide a private health insurance policy that includes visual and dental plan coverage.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to talentacquisition@jellyfish.com.

About the job

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

About The Company

Our client is a fast-growing marketing consultancy and growth agency specializing in the medical aesthetics and regenerative medicine sector. Operating globally across the US, UK, Australia, and beyond, the team helps premium clinics and MedSpas transition from inconsistent results to predictable, $100K+ monthly revenue. By moving beyond traditional lead generation, they implement comprehensive growth frameworks that optimize high-ticket patient acquisition, sales conversion systems, and client retention strategies for treatments like body sculpting, injectables, and advanced laser therapies.

As a performance-driven scale-up, the company is dedicated to solving the complex operational and marketing challenges faced by modern aesthetic practices. The team fosters a results-oriented and innovative environment, focusing on delivering measurable impact through structured systems rather than generic advertising. This is an opportunity to join a strategic, forward-thinking organization that is redefining how premium health and beauty businesses scale their operations in a competitive international market.

Job Summary

Most agencies stop caring once the lead lands. We don't. At this company, we recognize that the gap between an interested lead and a paid deposit is where high-ticket aesthetics is truly won or lost. We have world-class lead generation and robust systems; what we need is a dedicated CRO Lead to own the "click-to-booking" journey. You will turn anecdotal feedback into a systematic conversion machine, acting as the bridge between creative intelligence and bottom-line results. If you thrive on watching session recordings, debunking objections, and proving your hypotheses with hard evidence, this is the role where you can truly own the funnel.

About the job

DTC Marketing Specialist - Email, Social & Growth

Remote | Full-Time 

Reports To: Chief Growth Officer

Working Hours: Minimum 4-6 Hours Daily Overlap with U.S. Central Time

About The Company

We are a well-established consumer products company with a strong national brand presence and decades of customer loyalty built through innovation, quality, and memorable customer experiences.

As we continue investing in our direct-to-consumer growth strategy, we are looking for a highly strategic and data-driven Senior Brand Marketing Manager to lead campaign planning, lifecycle marketing, organic content strategy, influencer partnerships, agency management, and DTC revenue growth.

This is a highly autonomous role for someone who thrives in ownership-driven environments and enjoys making decisions that directly impact revenue performance.

You will not simply execute marketing initiatives—you will help determine what the company says, when it says it, where it says it, and how those efforts translate into measurable business growth.

Here is the revised, structured job description template based exactly on the comprehensive format provided, with all specific client details entirely removed and generalized.

DTC Marketing Specialist - Email, Social & Growth

Location: Remote | Full-Time

Reports To: Chief Growth Officer

Working Hours: Minimum 4-6 Hours Daily Overlap with U.S. Central Time

About The Company

We are a well-established consumer products company with a strong national brand presence and decades of customer loyalty built through innovation, quality, and memorable customer experiences.

As we continue investing in our direct-to-consumer growth strategy, we are looking for a highly strategic and data-driven DTC Marketing Specialist to lead campaign planning, lifecycle marketing, organic content strategy, influencer partnerships, agency management, and DTC revenue growth.

This is a highly autonomous role for someone who thrives in ownership-driven environments and enjoys making decisions that directly impact revenue performance. You will not simply execute marketing initiatives—you will help determine what the company says, when it says it, where it says it, and how those efforts translate into measurable business growth.

The Opportunity

This is not a social media management role. This is not a content coordination role.

This is a DTC growth leadership position responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue. You will serve as the strategic owner of multiple customer-facing marketing channels and become the primary driver behind campaign execution and performance optimization.

Success In This Role Requires a Unique Combination Of:


Brand strategy 
Campaign development 
Lifecycle marketing 
Data analysis 
Agency leadership 
Consumer psychology 
Ecommerce growth 


You will be expected to operate with a high degree of independence and bring recommendations backed by data rather than waiting for direction.

Note on Hands-On Execution: While you will own strategy and planning, you will also be expected to execute key marketing initiatives directly. You will build email campaigns, create marketing assets, manage agency relationships, develop campaign calendars, and drive marketing performance across multiple channels. This is not a people-management role; success requires both strategic thinking and executional excellence.

What You'll Own


 Campaign Strategy & Marketing Calendar


Own the annual, seasonal, and promotional marketing roadmap. Responsibilities include:


Developing integrated campaign strategies 
Building promotional calendars 
Planning product launches 
Mapping products and offers to seasonal demand cycles 
Defining campaign messaging and positioning 
Creating offers, promotions, and CTAs 
Coordinating execution across all marketing channels 


You will serve as the architect of the company's campaign ecosystem.


 Lifecycle Marketing & Email (Klaviyo)


Own the email channel as a major revenue-generating asset. Responsibilities include:


Designing and building email campaigns within Klaviyo 
Writing email copy and developing campaign messaging 
Creating and optimizing email templates 
Managing audience segmentation and lifecycle flows 
Driving list growth initiatives 
Analyzing email performance and implementing optimizations 


You should have personally managed a Klaviyo account and be comfortable discussing segmentation strategy, flow architecture, revenue attribution, deliverability, engagement metrics, and customer lifetime value.


 Organic Social Strategy


Lead the strategic direction of organic content initiatives. Responsibilities include:


Creating and publishing social media content 
Designing social graphics and campaign assets using Canva or similar tools 
Developing content themes aligned with campaign objectives 
Coordinating video content direction and creative execution 


Primary channels include: Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging social platforms. You should understand the distinct roles of social channels in the customer journey and be able to create content that supports both engagement and revenue objectives.


 Paid Agency Leadership


Act as the strategic owner of external paid media relationships. Responsibilities include:


Developing creative briefs 
Approving campaign direction 
Evaluating performance metrics 
Managing agency accountability 
Reviewing spend efficiency 
Optimizing customer acquisition efforts 
Ensuring alignment between paid media and broader campaign objectives 


The agency executes campaigns. You determine the strategy. You should be comfortable critically analyzing ROAS, CAC, CPA, conversion rates, revenue attribution, and audience performance to challenge agency data.


 Ecommerce & Website Content Strategy


Partner With And Provide Direction To Ecommerce Developers And Technical Resources To Improve Customer Acquisition, Conversion Rates, And Customer Experience. Responsibilities Include:


Directing landing page and campaign page development 
Defining content hierarchy and messaging strategy 
Writing or refining conversion-focused copy and CTAs 
Reviewing site experiences prior to launch (landing pages, product launch pages, promotional pages, and seasonal site experiences) 
 Influencer & Affiliate Marketing


Build and scale creator-driven growth initiatives from zero. Responsibilities include:


Program development and influencer recruitment 
Affiliate management and partnership negotiations 
Product seeding campaigns mapped against the marketing calendar 
Performance measurement and granular ROI analysis 


You will be responsible for establishing scalable creator relationships that support both brand awareness and revenue generation.


 Brand Stewardship


Serve as a guardian of the brand across all customer-facing channels. Responsibilities include:


Maintaining consistency across campaigns 
Reviewing and approving marketing materials and creative assets 
Protecting brand voice and positioning 
Ensuring alignment between performance marketing and long-term brand equity 
 Marketing Analytics & Performance Optimization


Use data to drive strategic decision-making. You will regularly analyze email performance, ecommerce metrics, social engagement, paid media performance, website conversion data, customer acquisition trends, retention metrics, and campaign ROI. Success will be measured by your ability to translate insights into actionable improvements.

Qualifications

Required


4-6+ years of experience in DTC Marketing, Brand Marketing, Growth Marketing, Ecommerce Marketing, or Lifecycle Marketing. 
Experience owning marketing channels and revenue outcomes from the inside of a consumer brand (agency-only experience does not qualify). 
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar lifecycle marketing platforms. 
Strong understanding of ecommerce and consumer marketing. 
Experience managing agencies and external partners. 
Proven ability to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns from scratch. 
Strong analytical and reporting skills. 
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 
Ability to work independently, build systems, and prioritize effectively. 


Preferred


Experience with Shopify-based brands. 
Experience building influencer or affiliate programs from scratch (rather than just managing an existing one). 
Experience in heritage, outdoor, lifestyle, recreation, or consumer products industries where voice and legacy matter. 
Familiarity with Google Analytics and ecommerce reporting platforms. 
Basic design proficiency in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite (fluent enough that simple assets never require an agency round-trip). 
Experience scaling DTC revenue channels. 


Ideal Candidate Profile

The Ideal Candidate:


Thinks like an owner: Highly self-directed, manages their own deadlines, and operates without a playbook. 
Makes decisions using data: Sees reporting as a weekly tool to steer strategy, not a month-end chore. 
Balances brand and performance: Understands customer psychology and how to protect a trusted brand legacy while aggressively driving revenue. 
Is a builder, not a briefer: Produces assets directly and can direct technical resources effectively (e.g., "the developer builds, you direct"). 


Success in the First 90 Days


Within 30 Days: Klaviyo account audited and first flow improvements live. Email calendar running on a consistent cadence. First agency briefs sent under your direction.

Compensation & Benefits


Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and location. 
Fully remote work environment. 
Significant ownership, autonomy, and direct collaboration with executive leadership. 
Opportunity to help shape the future growth of an established consumer brand with long-term career growth opportunities.

description:
About the job

About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

 

POSITION SUMMARY 

Own Workday integrations end-to-end, driving reliable data flow and scalable system design. Elevate architecture standards while bridging technical and business stakeholders. Enable high-quality user experiences through automated testing, reporting, and AI-driven insights. The Workday Integrations & Data Specialist is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining integrations between Workday and internal or third-party systems. This role ensures accurate, secure, and timely data flow across HR, payroll, finance, IT, and benefits platforms while supporting reporting, automation, AI-enabled insights, and scalable system design.

This role partners closely with HRIS, IT, Finance, Payroll, Core HCM architects, and external vendors to ensure Workday functions as a reliable system of record within a cohesive technology ecosystem. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Workday Integrations & Data Management

Design, build, test, and maintain Workday integrations using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and APIs
Manage integrations across payroll, benefits, identity management, finance systems, data warehouses, and other HR platforms
Ensure data integrity through transformation logic, mapping, and bulk data operations

Monitor integrations, troubleshoot failures, and resolve data discrepancies

Partner with functional teams (e.g., Talent, Payroll, Benefits) to enable effective test plans and issue identification
Contribute to a high-quality user experience by ensuring data accuracy and system reliability across workflows

Collaboration & Communication

Partner with Core HCM architects and business process administrators across SKUs including Talent and Advanced Compensation, to ensure cohesive, end-to-end system design
Translate complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences
Collaborate across HR, IT, Finance, and vendors to align solutions with business needs

Security & Compliance

Ensure integrations meet security, privacy, and compliance standards
Manage secure data transfers and authentication methods across systems

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

4+ years of experience with Workday integrations and tools such as: Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Web Services / APIs
Experience integrating Workday with systems such as:
ADP / global payroll vendors
Okta/identity management
Greenhouse / ATS

SUCCESS METRICS

About the job

Description

Our Procurement team is a new organization being strongly customer centric-focused by living a transformational environment needed to meet our leadership principles by working hard, having fun and making history.

We are seeking a leader with procurement experience to strategically source products and services for MX Customer Fulfillment Procurement.

As a Site Procurement Manager for Operations, you will own the procurement operation responsibilities, including category procurement for the site for Directs and indirects (Products and Services), vendor management, , contract management, forecast analysis, Procure to Pay, Category functions for network and sites day to day activities, projects and monitoring vendor performance.

You will also lead supplier management KPI´s and metrics reporting, as well as develop and work with stakeholders to find and understand deviation and improvement areas. You will provide procurement leadership for the locations and alignment with building leadership team to drive efficiencies and improvements in the building.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter, and a creative, critical thinker with a motivation to learn. You must be an effective communicator and be able to work independently and as a leader of peers to generate high-quality work product in a collaborative, creative, ever-changing, and sometimes ambiguous environment. You must have a professional demeanor and be able to partner with people at every level.

#AmazonMexico

Key job responsibilities


 Align with the Regional Procurement Manager to provide procurement operations for the building, including: non-inventory services, supplier management, sourcing and negotiation, procurement transaction, projects of innovation and expediting support as needed.
 Establish category sourcing strategies, lead cross-functional strategic sourcing teams, negotiate with suppliers and execute contracts to optimize Amazon’s competitive position
 Drive appropriate relationships with category suppliers, with a principal objective of achieving the optimal solution and cost of ownership that meets the business’ goals supported by a culture of continuous improvement with performance benchmarks in use
 Reporting to the Country Procurement and Key Stakeholders key milestones on a Weekly & Monthly basis about services performance and actions needed (service, experience, improvements, new projects).
 Lead the operational procurement process.

 Develop relationship across the building and network of Procurement and other sites.
 Align with Internal customers, Finance and Procurement Operations to understand budgetary targets by building to develop an agreed method of measuring and defining savings, value and other category metrics.
 Project Management.

 To measure actual vs planned savings and advice team of trends, escalate issues and own action plans.
 Manage MBRs and QBRs.
 Experience related to Commute, Logistics and transportation, employee transportation, Services.


A day in the life


 Daily monitoring on the performance of all sites.
 Improvement opportunities related to services.
 Attend critical escalations + Action plan or task force as needed.
 Networking with key stakeholders, functions and suppliers to collaborate into the best value added improvements needed for the operation.
 identify weak and vulnerabilities on our internal operative process and flag any potential risk.
 Business Continuity process to maintain operation in case of contingencies.
 Project Management

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

•Control y reportología de ejecución de presupuesto y tiempos real vs plan

Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Mecatrónica, Ingeniería Civil, Arquitectura

MS Office (excel, power point, project, Visio). Deseable: Herramientas IA




“En Walmart de México y Centroamérica estamos comprometidos as con una cultura de pertenencia, por lo que buscamos incorporar el mejor talento basándonos en competencias, habilidades y potencial; no discriminamos por ningún motivo, incluyendo género, edad, origen étnico, apariencia física, estado civil, condiciones de salud por VIH o cualquier enfermedad, situación socioeconómica, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género

skills: Plan, activate, optimize, and manage paid search and paid social campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, TikTok, and X.
Translate client objectives and communication strategies into effective search and social campaign recommendations.
Develop campaign structures, audience strategies, keyword approaches, bidding strategies, budget allocations, and testing plans.
Make activation and investment decisions based on client goals, audience insights, customer journeys, and campaign performance.
Manage performance against conversion-focused metrics such as CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, CLV, and lead-to-sale ratio.
Use client, platform, and proprietary data to refine targeting, adjust media investments, and identify opportunities for campaign expansion.
Apply a test-and-learn approach to creative, audiences, keywords, bidding, placements, and campaign structure.
Oversee the full campaign lifecycle, including setup, trafficking, optimization, troubleshooting, reporting, forecasting, and billing.
Ensure brand safety, fraud prevention, tracking accuracy, and data-quality transparency across campaigns.
Support audits of prospective and existing client search and social accounts.
Develop comprehensive paid search and social activation plans aligned with each client’s business goals and customer journey.
Anticipate client needs and provide proactive, data-informed recommendations.
Present campaign performance, analysis, and insights clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
Explain platform strategies, investment decisions, results, and optimization recommendations in accessible business terms.
Build trusted client relationships through responsive communication, reliable execution, and strategic guidance.
Collaborate with strategy, planning, analytics, creative, CX, and investment teams to deliver a cohesive consumer experience across channels.
Work closely with media planning teams to manage campaign delivery and provide ongoing optimization recommendations.
Coordinate creative requirements, tracking needs, reporting expectations, and campaign timelines across internal and client teams.
Contribute search and social expertise to broader media planning and business-review discussions.
Support and mentor junior team members by sharing platform knowledge and activation best practices.
Help establish and refine paid search and social activation standards and best practices.
Stay current on platform changes, privacy developments, measurement capabilities, emerging technologies, and industry trends.
Identify new platform features, buying strategies, and testing opportunities that could improve client outcomes.
Participate in professional development and contribute meaningfully within areas of subject-matter expertise.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, business, or a related field preferred.
Three or more years of hands-on experience managing paid search and paid social campaigns.
Experience working in direct-response, commerce, performance marketing, or growth-focused environments.
Working knowledge of Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads Manager, and additional social platforms such as LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, TikTok, or X.

About the job
